fusions.name: Death Roll
fusions.desc: Grips the target and twists for 18 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Drowning Hold
fusions.desc: Clamps both hands onto the target for 30 damage, leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. The hit is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Hair-Trigger Jaws
fusions.desc: Sets a jaw trap at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds and deals 22 damage to the first enemy to come within 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Never Lets Go
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
